title: Parseval identity on the sign cube
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set and let $f:\{\pm1\}^{\iota}\to\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_x[f(x)^2]=\sum_{S\subseteq\iota}\widehat f(S)^2$, where $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_y[f(y)\prod_{i\in S}y_i]$ and both expectations are uniform over sign assignments.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on sign assignments
